digest.component_or_area: store initialization and project mapping migration
propositions: Existing stores lack `.bridge_state/projects.json` and `bridge_project` fields on tickets, causing sync to fail on upgrade unless migrated without writing per-ticket events.

Two idempotent ensure units must seed the projects mapping with a `legacy_default` and converge the `multi-project-bridge` capability stamp, both check-then-act with zero writes when already converged.
The seed unit creates `.bridge_state/projects.json` with `legacy_default` equal to `Backend.project` only if absent and tickets exist; a second sweep writes nothing and returns `ok`.
The capability-stamp unit adds `multi-project-bridge` to `required_capabilities` only when the mapping contains more than one project, serving as a convergence backstop.
The migration writes zero ticket events (no EDIT-per-ticket), making it safe to run during MCP boot on a short lock budget without silent skip or unpredictable convergence.
Integration tests validate idempotence, zero-event guarantee, conditional stamping (one-project vs. multi-project), compat-gate safety, and failure isolation.
